title: The Whirling Crystal
subtitle: From Fregean Predication to Belnap’s FOUR, Chu Spaces, the Gyrobifastigial Cell, and the Spatiotemporal Manifold of Knowledge
author: 561 Group
description: A working account of a live mathematics program, tracing a path from Fregean predicate application through Belnap’s FOUR, Chu spaces and Hoare programs to the gyrobifastigial cell, the dervish defect, witnessed time, thermodynamic cost and an executable inference kernel.
